metadata.name: GetAccountControl
metadata.description: This API is to get the defined account controls on a product for different Merchants.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Currency Code Ex. 840 = US Doller. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language ==  en: means use English ---- es: means Spanish Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AccountControlDetails
children.description: List of all the Account  controls details defined on Product.

children.name: MerchantID
children.description: Unique number of merchant account Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXX Example: 205136549

children.name: AccountControlTableName
children.description: Name of Account Controls like Interest, Payment , Processing Parameters defined etc when defining any Product. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:1

children.name: PrimaryCurrencyCode
children.description: Primary Currency Code for that Product. Valid Values:0-9, A-z Format:XX Example:US Dollar Allowable Values: 25

children.name: AccountControlTableParent
children.description: Parent Name of Account Controls like Interest, Payment , Processing Parameters defined etc when defining any Product. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:12

children.name: MonetaryTransactionControlGroup
children.description: Group defined on a product for its monetary transaction like defining Fees, Interest, Transactioncodes etc. Like XXX_MTCG Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:21

children.name: PurchasePlanMaster
children.description: This field is to set the default Purchase Plan Master for the Merchant. Like XXXX_Regular_Revolving Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:12

children.name: CashPlanMaster
children.description: This field is to set the default Cash Plan Master for the Merchant. Like XXXX_Regular_Revolving Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:22

children.name: DefaultBalanceTransferPlan
children.description: This field is to set the default Balance Transfer Plan for the Merchant. Format:XX Example:Ignite Balance Transfer plan Allowable Values: 100

children.name: OverlimitBalance
children.description: OverlimitBalance for Payment Calculation Basis to define the payment controls as 0-Include 1-Add-On 2-Exclude 3-ADD-On Unbilled Unpaid Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:0,1

children.name: CashLimitMethod
children.description: Cash limit method can be set to Amount or Percent of total credit line. Valid Values: 0 = Amount 1 = Percent of Total Credit Line Example:0,1

children.name: CashLimitAmount
children.description: Amount set for Amount cash limit method. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXX.XXX Example:1000.00

children.name: CashLimitPercentage
children.description: Percent of total credit limit set for Percent cash limit method. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XX.XX Example:1.00

children.name: GeneralFeeDisclosureMethod
children.description: To define the General Fee Disclosure, values as 0-No disclosure necessary 1-Disclose X cycles before assessment is effective 2-Disclose on same statement as assessment Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XX.XX Example:0,1,2

children.name: GeneralFeeDisclosureCycles
children.description: To define the General Fee Disclosure, Cycles values as 0 to 12 Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XX.XX Example:0,1,2

children.name: AccountBillingTypeMethod
children.description: To define the method of Billing type on Account as Revolving or Invoiced 0-Invoiced 1-Revolving Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XX.XX Example:0,1

children.name: MerchantCategoryCodeGroupName
children.description: Name of the Merchant Category Code. Eg- 1- MCC Group 1 Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XX.XX Example:1

children.name: PenaltyPriceLevel
children.description: Indicates if penalty pricing is applied at account or plan level. Valid Values: Account/Plan Example:Account Allowable Values: 10

children.name: PenaltyPricingApplyAmount
children.description: Indicates if penalty pricing will be applied on entire current balance or only on future transactions occurring after 45 days. Valid Values: Current Balance, Future Transaction Balance Example:Current Balance Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AccountStatusforPenaltyPricing
children.description: Indicates the status in which account will be moved if penalty pricing is applied on account. Valid Values: List of account statuses applicable for the institution Example:9974 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PenaltyPricingOptOutAccountStatus
children.description: Indicates the status in which account will be moved if customer opts out of penalty pricing. Valid Values: List of account statuses applicable for the institution Example:10557 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PenaltyInterestTableOccurrence
children.description: Indicates Interest table occurrence number for penalty pricing. Valid Values: 1 to 24 Example: 5 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: NumberOfDaysBeforePenaltyPricingApplied
children.description: Indicates number of days system will wait and inform customer before applying penalty pricing on its account. Valid Values: 15 to 100 Example: 45

children.name: AdvancedPenaltyPricingMethodLogicName
children.description: Indicates advanced logic name which will be applied to set Penalty Pricing on account. Valid Values: 1/2 Example:1 Allowable Values: 10

children.name: DynamicRuleGroupArrayForMethod
children.description: DynamicRuleGroupArrayForMethod

children.name: DynamicRuleGroupName
children.description: Rule Name provided for dynamic penalty price logic. This has to be unique to uniquely identify dynamic logic. Valid Values: A-Z a-z 0-9 Example: Client1CurePenalty1 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: ParameterName
children.description: Variable based on which rule will be configured. Valid Values: Returned Payment, Late Fee Charged, DPD Example: Returned Payment Allowable Values: 50

children.name: Operator1
children.description: Defines mathematical operator used to check the value for ParameterName or Duration field. Valid Values: Mathematical operator(it,gt,gt eq,it eq,eq,it gt) Example: = Allowable Values: 10

children.name: AmountOrCount1
children.description: Defines value for Parameter Name / Duration field. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 2

children.name: ValueOrPercent1
children.description: Defines attribute of value defined in ‘AmountorCount1’ field. Valid Values: Percent, Amount, Days, Cycles, Value, Count Example: Amount Allowable Values: 50

children.name: Duration
children.description: Defines time period for which activity mentioned in other fields will be checked. Valid Values: Days, Weeks, Months, Years Example: Weeks Allowable Values: 50

children.name: Operator2
children.description: Defines mathematical operator used to check the value for ParameterName or Duration field. Valid Values: Example: > Allowable Values: 10

children.name: AmountOrCount2
children.description: Defines value for Parameter Name / Duration field. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 2

children.name: ValueOrPercent2
children.description: Defines attribute of value defined in ‘AmountorCount2’ field. Valid Values: Percent, Amount, Days, Cycles, Value, Count Example: Amount Allowable Values: 50

children.name: LogicalOperator
children.description: This field is required when we need to club more than one rules and mention if they need to be ANDed or ORed together. Valid Values: AND, OR, END Example: AND Allowable Values: 10

children.name: AdditionalLogicalOperator
children.description: In case combination of ‘OR’ and ‘AND’ where we need to group conditions, we need to use this field and ‘LogicalOperator’ field. Valid Values: AND, OR Example: AND Allowable Values: 10

children.name: MinimumInterestCalculationMethod
children.description: This is to define the Minimum Interest Calculation Method for Interest Controls as 0-Do not waive interest 1-Calculate minimum at account level 2-Calculate minimum at plan level Valid Values:0-9 Format:X Example:1,2

children.name: ConsiderationofDeferredInterest
children.description: This is to define the Consideration of Deferred Interest for Interest Controls as 0-Consider deferred interest only when charged 1-Consider deferred interest per cycle Valid Values:0-9 Format:X Example:0,1

children.name: MinimumInterestAmount
children.description: Minimum Interest Amount set  for Interest Controls Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example:22.00

children.name: AccrueInterestonChargedOffAccounts
children.description: This is to define the Accrue Interest on Charged Off Accounts for Interest Controls as 0-Do not accrue interest 1-Accrue interest Valid Values:0-9 Format:X Example:0,1

children.name: InterestDisclosureMethod
children.description: This is to define the Interest Disclosure Method for Interest Controls as 0-No disclosure necessary 1-Disclose X cycles before assessment is effective 2- Disclose on same statement as assessment Valid Values:0-9 Format:X Example:0,1

children.name: InterestDisclosureCycles
children.description: This is to define the Interest Disclosure Cycles for Interest Controls as 0 - 12 Valid Values:0-9 Format:X Example:0,1

children.name: AccruedInterestWaiverLimit
children.description: Indicates the limit to waive off the accrued Interest amount if it is the only component to bill. Valid Values:  0-9 Format: X Example:25.00

children.name: SegmentsSubjectToGraceDays
children.description: This is to define the Segments Subject To Grace Days for Interest Controls as 0	Do not use grace days 1	Cash and purchase plans 2	Cash plans only 3	Purchase plans only 4	Use credit plan master grace days application Valid Values:0-9 Format:X Example:0,1

children.name: GraceDaysMethod
children.description: This is to define the Grace Days Method for Interest Controls as 0-Next cycle date 1-Use number of grace days from Statement Date 2- Use number of grace days from Payment Due Date Valid Values:0-9 Format:X Example:0,1

children.name: NumberofGraceDays
children.description: This is to define the Number of Grace Daysfor Interest Controls as 0-45 Valid Values:0-9 Format:X Example:0,1

children.name: PreviousCycleGrace
children.description: This is to define the Previous Cycle Grace for Interest Controls as Yes/No Valid Values:0-1 Format:X Example:0,1

children.name: UsePartialGraceDays
children.description: This is to define the Use Partial Grace Days for Interest Controls as Yes/No Valid Values:0-1 Format:X

children.name: InterestOnGraceReactivation
children.description: This is to define the Interest On Grace Reactivation for Interest Controls as 1	Waive on new and revolving 2	Accrue on new and revolving 3	Accrue on revolving till payment 4	Accrue on revolving till statement Valid Values:1-4 Format:X Example:1

children.name: BalanceSubjectToGraceOn
children.description: This is to define the Balance Subject To Grace On for Interest Controls as 0- Account 1- Plan Valid Values:0-1 Format:X Example:0,1

children.name: ContractualDelinquencyMethod
